title: Canary GitHub real · barrier rendezvous + carrera de pin
mission: Independently exercise CONTENTION_START_BARRIER_CANDIDATE_V1 on real GitHub with exactly two genuinely distinct /wc workers. Before any portfolio pin attempt, each worker may create only its own no-authority entrant receipt under the predeclared live-pin-barrier-canary-v1 fixture and remain in a bounded active rendezvous loop. Once two distinct entrants exist before deadline, contenders race the same deterministic G000001 portfolio pin; winner creates the matching claim, loser creates no claim, persists prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1 and re-enters allocation. If deadline arrives before release, create timeout evidence and do not attempt a pin. No production /w or product-state promotion.
definition_of_done: Two distinct /wc worker_ids have append-only entrant receipts under coordination/portfolio/contention_barriers/live-pin-barrier-canary-v1/entrants/.
Exactly one RELEASE.json exists and its entrant_worker_ids contain the two distinct contenders; RELEASE states grants_execution_authority=false.
After RELEASE exactly one G000001 portfolio pin winner exists for this job and exactly one matching authoritative claim exists.
Exactly one losing contender persists prometeo.portfolio-pin-collision/v1, creates no authoritative claim and records next_action=REENTER_ALLOCATION.
If the deadline is missed instead, no G000001 pin exists and entrant timeout evidence records REENTER_ALLOCATION; this is a bounded canary outcome, not a pass.
A terminal VERIFIED return is allowed only for the full released-race path; timeout or incomplete rendezvous remains PARTIAL/BOUNDARY.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
